findings: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ147. The user throws two initial Ki blasts; if both connect, a larger Ki wave follows for a source-reported 30% total damage. Back input before the first throw sends the first projectile behind the user, after which the move continues normally. Exact projectile timing, scaling, and reward probability remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
Unsupported exact frames, hidden gates, probabilities, and patch-independent scaling are not promoted.
Documented acquisition/reward conflicts remain explicit rather than normalized without evidence.
